product_summary: Lee Pharma Limited (Moosapet, Balanagar, Hyderabad, Telangana — note: site address is Hyderabad/Telangana, not Andhra Pradesh as claimed) is an API + formulation + CDMO manufacturer since 1997, claiming USFDA/EU-GMP/WHO-GMP approvals and supply to 30+ countries. The 'API' page (leepharma.com/api) lists a commercial portfolio of ~50 APIs, all small-molecule synthetic drugs: statins/anti-hyperlipidemics (rosuvastatin calcium, bempedoic acid), antiplatelets/anticoagulants (ticagrelor, prasugrel HCl, apixaban, dabigatran etexilate base and mesylate), antidiabetics (sitagliptin phosphate monohydrate, sitagliptin HCl, alogliptin, dapagliflozin, empagliflozin amorphous and crystalline, teneligliptin HCl/HBr, saxagliptin, vildagliptin, linagliptin Form C), urology (darifenacin HBr, tamsulosin HCl), anticonvulsants (pregabalin, lacosamide, mirogabalin besylate, brivaracetam), PPIs/antiulcer (pantoprazole sodium sesquihydrate, pantoprazole magnesium dihydrate, lansoprazole, dexlansoprazole, esomeprazole Mg dihydrate/trihydrate, esomeprazole sodium, omeprazole, omeprazole magnesium, rabeprazole sodium), antipsychotics (ziprasidone HCl, lurasidone HCl, olanzapine Forms I/II), antidepressant (sertraline HCl Form II), antihistamine (bilastine, montelukast sodium), antivirals (raltegravir potassium, remdesivir, favipiravir), antibiotics (moxifloxacin HCl, linezolid Form II), antifungals (voriconazole, itraconazole), ibandronate sodium, varenicline tartrate/base, and GnRH antagonists relugolix sodium and elagolix sodium. The site also advertises 'Pellets & Granules', 'Finished Formulations' and 'CDMO' as separate focus areas (pages not reachable — 404 on /formulation, /our-focus, /products), so the dosage-form range is stated but not itemised.
role_hint: manufacturer (own API plants, DMF/CEP filings, USFDA/EU-GMP claims); also offers CDMO and formulations — no trader signs found on the site
comment: Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a misclassification: the company is a pharmaceutical API/formulation manufacturer (organic fine chemicals / pharma), not petrochemicals. HS mapping: the declared block 2933xx (293339, 293399) is broadly correct and covers the bulk of the portfolio — the pyridine-ring PPIs (pantoprazole, lansoprazole, esomeprazole, omeprazole, rabeprazole) sit in 2933.39, while the remaining heterocyclics (statins, gliptins, gliflozins, antipsychotics, antivirals, azoles, quinolones) fall in 2933.49/2933.59/2933.99 — so the declaration is directionally right but under-specified at HS-6 for the largest group (2933.49, incl. rosuvastatin, sitagliptin, apixaban, dabigatran). Declared 292145 (1-naphthylamine derivatives) is NOT corroborated by any product on the site — likely a legacy/erroneous line; declared 293090 (other organo-sulphur) is likewise not corroborated by the published API list (possible for intermediates such as esomeprazole/rabeprazole thio-intermediates, but no evidence on site). Missing from the declaration: finished formulations / pellets & granules (would be Ch.30, e.g. 3004.90) and any CDMO dosage-form output. All product names above are 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — they come from the company's own API page (https://www.leepharma.com/api), not from any customs line; no shipment or customs record was checked in this task. Verdict per Rule 3: HS mismatch is not a rejection ground — company retained, codes corrected/expanded to 2933.49 / 2933.59 / 2933.99 / 2933.39 as primary, with 2921.45 and 2930.90 flagged as uncorroborated and Ch.30 lines added for formulations.
